data.one_liner: A Pedometer and Step Detection package for Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Allows for continuous step counting and pedestrian status using built-in pedometer sensor APIs on iOS and Android devices. Step counts and pedestrian status are streamed as platform updates occur.
use_when: You need to track step counts continuously in your app
You need to detect pedestrian status (walking or stopped)
avoid_when: Targeting older phones or specific Samsung devices that do not support step count or pedestrian status sensors
You need historical step counts from before application installation on Android
strengths: Supports pedestrian status detection (walking vs stopped)
Cross-platform support for both Android and iOS
weaknesses: Sensor availability varies across device models (some Samsung and older iPhones lack support)
Requires manual platform configuration and permission handling
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION permission for Android 10+ and NSMotionUsageDescription along with UIBackgroundModes to iOS Info.plist.
